## Checklist

- [ ] `just ci` passes locally (fmt, clippy, tests)
- [ ] `just conformance` was run and the updated `conformance/STATUS.md` is included (if the engine changed)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`); the DCO check requires it
- [ ] New behavior has unit tests
- [ ] Code ported from kustomize or Flux has an attribution header, and `NOTICE` covers any new upstream material
